description: Phone number check. Use when a task needs to know whether a phone number is valid for its country, what kind of number it is (mobile, landline, toll-free, premium rate, VoIP) and its E.164, national and international formats. Formats, country and type are only returned for valid numbers; an invalid number keeps its E.164 form only when its length is possible, and e164 is null for any number longer than the 15 digits E.164 allows. The phone input may be a plain number or an RFC 3966 tel: URI, so the uri from an earlier answer can be fed straight back in. Checked offline: no carrier or live-line lookup. Cost: 1 credit per call.

default_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code to read a national-format number against.

phone.description: The number, as digits or as an RFC 3966 tel: URI, so the uri from an earlier answer can be fed straight back in.

name: phone_parse
